featured_reviews.name: Indrani Bhattacherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are truly grateful to Dr. Vimal Pandey at Supreme Pet Clinic & Care Centre for being there .

During an emergency late at night, the doctor responded with care, patience, and practical guidance when we were extremely stressed. One suggestion that made a huge difference in Pastry’s recovery was introducing syringe feeding when she was refusing food and becoming weak. That timely advice genuinely helped us stabilize her nutrition and supported her progress.

Thank you for being available in emergencies, for handling her gently, and for supporting us through a critical time. We’ll always remember the care and reassurance we received here.

featured_reviews.name: menka adhikari
featured_reviews.review_text:
My dog became paralyzed after the treatment and advice given by this veterinary doctor. This has been one of the most heartbreaking experiences for me as a pet owner.

My dog only had a mild cold due to AC during travel, but the doctor (Vimal Pandey- Money-hungry) misdiagnosed the condition and said that the liver, kidney and teeth were damaged. He suggested unnecessary tests like sonography and gave around 10 injections without proper explanation.

Instead of proper treatment, it felt like he is focus was only on making money. Around ₹9,000 was charged for unnecessary tests, injections and medicines, but my dog’s condition kept getting worse.

We were also advised to give glucose water during the journey, after which my dog’s body retained excess fluid and soon she lost movement in her back legs and became paralyzed.

Pet owners trust vets with their animals’ lives. I strongly advise others to take a second opinion before visiting this doctor.
I gave one star, but honestly this doctor doesn’t even deserve that. What happened to my dog because of this treatment is heartbreaking. God sees everything, and I truly believe karma will come back to this person one day.

On biochem liver values are  also elevated. Above all diagnostics it indicated that your pet is having tick fever which is life threatening if didn't do proper treatment. 
For the treatment we need to give iv fluids and antibiotics which require costings. On abdominal palpation there was severe pain which can indicates splenomegaly which needs to confirm by USG thats why it's adviced.we started proper treatment but after 1 day of treatment you guys decided to halt the treatment coz you are not able to come from tomorrow which was your call and also you didnt tell us the reason also why you  can't come. Which shows how neglected behaviour towards your pets inspite of having life threatening diseases. My advice is don't take pets if you can't give proper treatment and care. And also the expenses were 7170 /- including treatment, medicine and diagnostics.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Chohan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to thank Supreme pet clinic (Dr.vimal pandey ji) for providing care and treatment for animals in our area. As an animal rescuer/feeder, I truly value the efforts of vets who dedicate themselves to saving lives and keeping our community animals healthy.

One humble request: please consider offering concessions/discounts for animal feeders and caregivers. We often take care of several strays at once, covering sterilizations, vaccinations, and emergency treatments from our own pockets. A little support from kind clinics like yours can help us continue this work and extend care to many more voiceless souls.

Your compassion towards not just pets but also community animals makes a huge difference. Thank you for being a pillar of support for animal welfare. 🙏🐾
